title: Bone.land Resonance
logline: Bone.land is the small constitution — the spine that holds when the veil shakes.
epigraph: Skeleton first; ornament after the load path is honest.
description: Chapter 10 of Lore.Land: Bone.land Resonance. Structure itself becomes the concert. The four laws — cell, key, turn, receipt — are load-bearing here. The egg nests in the crossing of two beams like a kernel.

content.text: The great frame did not pretend to be entertainment. Joints were exposed on purpose. Each beam felt load-bearing — until, with a sudden thud, a loud

children.text: ran through the hall. Not slapstick. Contact with irreversible structure. The egg nested where two beams crossed, a kernel in the spine. Four laws were carved, unornamented, along the load path: a cell keeps its own law; a key may be filed smaller; a turn is an act admitted; a receipt is the slip that remains.

content.text: The sound was jarring, a shockwave through honest timber. It was as if the world itself had hit a wall and the wall had held. Boof was dazed and, for the first time since the furrow, unsurprised. Structure that tells the truth sounds like that.
"Ah, Boof," the Fool's voice was closer now, almost tangible. "You’ve reached the chassis. Not all endings are the ones we expect. Sometimes you just get bonked by a law that will not yield."

img.alt: A great load-bearing wooden frame, gold seams along honest joints, the cracked egg nested in the crossing of two beams.

content.text: Boof sat a moment in the hum of the frame. The bonk was sudden and inevitable. What a cell holds, if you ask the beams, is four substances dressed as town-words: worth, weather, keys, and proof — value, state, authority, evidence, spoken so a dog can smell them. The egg in the crossing did not decorate the hall. It was the kernel the hall was built to carry.

content.text: "Is this how it ends?" Boof asked. The Fool answered with a quieter bonk — a door closing on ornament, another opening on a stair that bloomed before it was planted.

loreItems.description: Bone.land is the chassis realm: persistence, scaffold, and the ethics of what carries weight.
The small constitution is load-bearing here: cell, key, turn, receipt.
The bonk at the threshold is not slapstick — it is contact with irreversible structure.
